title: Nomad Boxing Club

services.name: Adult Boxing
services.desc: A fun, safe, and structured boxing program for kids ages 6 to 10 at Nomad Boxing Club in Ballard, Seattle. Build confidence, coordination, and discipline while having a blast. Our Kids Boxing program for ages 6 to 10 is designed to introduce children to the sport of boxing in a fun, safe, and age-appropriate way. Every class focuses on movement, coordination, listening skills, and the fundamentals of boxing. All of these are taught in a positive, encouraging environment. Coach Manny and the Nomad team understand that kids this age need structure, patience, and above all, fun. We use games, challenges, and partner drills to keep kids engaged while building the physical and mental foundation

services.name: Adult Programs
services.desc: Nomad Boxing Club's Youth Boxing program for teens ages 12 to 18. Build real boxing skills, discipline, and confidence in a proven, supportive environment led by Coach Manny. Our Youth Boxing program for ages 12 to 18 is one of the most impactful programs at Nomad Boxing Club. Teenagers learn real boxing technique alongside character development, discipline, and the kind of confidence that carries into every part of their lives. Many teens join our evening adult classes once they've built a strong foundation. They hold their own right alongside adult members. Coach Manny treats every young athlete with respect, holds them to high standards, and becomes a genuine mentor for many of the youth
